subject: Adding Bloom command JSON files (#47)
reason: The change only adds static JSON command-documentation files under src/commands/ (and a trailing newline in .gitignore). Nothing consumes them: valkey-bloom has no build.rs and no include_str!/include_bytes! or other reference to src/commands/; all BF.* commands, their arity, flags and ACL categories are registered by the valkey_module! macro in src/lib.rs, which is unchanged. The compiled module is identical on both sides of the change, so there is no runtime behaviour to test.
